question: Famed Bharatnatyam exponent and founder of Kalakshetra, Rukmini Devi Arundale was the proud recipient of 1956 _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Bhushan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padma Bhushan** was awarded to Rukmini Devi Arundale in 1956.
 
• Rukmini Devi Arundale was a famed Bharatnatyam exponent and the founder of Kalakshetra.
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India, given for distinguished service of a high order in any field.
 
• Kalakshetra, founded by Rukmini Devi, is an arts and cultural academy dedicated to the preservation of traditional values in Indian art and crafts, especially in the field of Bharatanatyam dance and music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Padma Awards** were instituted in 1954 and are announced every year on Republic Day.
 
• The awards are given in three categories: Padma Vibhushan (for exceptional and distinguished service), Padma Bhushan (for distinguished service of a high order), and Padma Shri (for distinguished service).
 
• Rukmini Devi Arundale was also instrumental in the revival of Bharatanatyam, which was earlier considered a low art form.
 
• She was nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of India's Parliament, in 1952.
